[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
It says you don't have the core lib installed, it is required for the newest version.

[comment by luffykick (none)]
Same issue as OP... but for clarity... your latest trashcans update "trashcans-1.0.10-mc1.16.5" is now requiring "supermartijn642**corelib**-1.0.3-mc1.16.5" 

Many of us have "supermartijn642**configlib**-1.0.5a-mc1.16" which is where the confusion comes in... its easy to confuse config with core without paying close attention.

Might be a good idea to put that in bold on the Trashcans curseforge page to avoid confusion from OG fans.

[comment by moon-st0ne (none)]
why the hell does this mod require its own library mod now

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
Because I make like 14 mods for different 5 Minecraft versions and I don't want to have to repeat the same code constantly.

[comment by SuperMartijn642 (owner)]
@Warbringer12 I assume your problem is solved now. If not, just comment here and I'll reopen the issue.
